title: Marco Polo Airport
summary: Macro Polo Airport is an airport located in Venice, Italy.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Dante Vale, Sophie Casterwill, Cherit, and Lok Lambert took a flight at Marco Polo Airport for Prague, Czech Republic, in search of information on the Amulet of Will. Santiago was initially opposed to Sophie travelling abroad, but he allowed Dante to take her with him after he took a Raypulse that was intended for her at the Venice Huntik Library. [The Casterwill Client]

Sophie tried to buy plane tickets for Egypt at the airport, but her cards kept getting declined. She was later informed that The Organization had blocked all her funds. This led Sophie and Lok to take part-time jobs to try and pay for the tickets, but Dante bought them out of his own pocket for the sake of the mission. [All Work and No Pay]
